items.title: Y1 ABM8-272-T3 12 MHz 3225
items.recommendation: Do not swap. Only basic 12 MHz crystal is YXC X322512MSB4SI C9002 (SMD3225-4P, 208k stock, $0.0954): CL 20 pF, ESR 80 ohm, +-10 ppm initial/+-20 ppm. No preferred 12 MHz crystal exists.
designer_checks: RP2040 reference (ABM8-272-T3) is CL 10 pF, ESR <= 50 ohm with 15 pF load caps and 1k series (R10). C9002 would need C ~ 2*(20-Cstray) ~ 30-34 pF (33 pF C0G C1663 and 22 pF C0G C1653 are both basic) and has 60 % more ESR.

Negative-resistance margin scales ~ gm/(w^2 C1 C2): 33/33 pF vs 15/15 pF is ~4.8x lower margin, on top of ESR 80 vs 50 ohm -> real start-up risk, needs a start-up test over temperature (agrees with docs/rev-d-audit.md).
If C9002 were fitted with the existing 15 pF caps it would be under-loaded (frequency high); the DDS tuning-word frequency depends on the PLL from this crystal.

dc_bias_C13585.source_note: Samsung SEM product page for family CL31A106KBHNNN# (packaging suffixes E/F listed on the same page; curve labelled partsName CL31A106KBHNNN). Curve is the DCBias entry of the page's embedded `var datasheetData` JSON (graphType DCBias, axis DeltaC in %). Page disclaimer: typical data for design reference only. Read by linear interpolation of 141 sorted (V, dC%) points; retained fraction = 1 + dC/100. No CSV/KSIM file downloaded (S2P/SPICE sit behind the page's Download links).

measurement_conditions_in_json.note: dsDcSign=1.0 is the AC-level field in Samsung's data; unit (Vrms) not stated on the page - assumed 1 Vrms class.

dc_bias_C13585.reading: All four regulator_check break-even thresholds (which already include -10% tolerance and -15% temperature) are met by C13585, but margins are thin at the 12 V LDO COUT (0.339 vs 0.288, +18%; about 0.33 at the 12.3 V max output) and the 5 V input (0.728 vs 0.61, +19%). C13585 keeps about 2.5x less capacitance than the current CL32B part at ~15 V (0.255 vs 0.655). The script's assumed retention (0.4 for <=35% of rating, 0.25 above) is not what this curve gives at 12 V (0.339 < 0.4), so regulator_check needs re-baselining with this curve before a swap is called a pass. Effective COUT per LDO at 12 V, one 10uF part alone: 10*0.339*0.9*0.85 = 2.6 uF vs 2.2 uF minimum (plus the 3x1uF and 100 nF at the amplifiers). Curve is 25 C, 1 kHz typical, not worst-case; X5R also loses capacitance at 85 C.

srv05_4_C7420376.how_obtained: The wmsc.lcsc.com URL in the JLC record answers with a JS redirect to this datasheet.lcsc.com path; fetched with a browser User-Agent and Referer https://www.lcsc.com/; text via pdftotext and page 1 rendered to read the function diagram.

pinout.pin_5: V05 rail pin (diode-steering rail with an internal Zener to GND; connect to VBUS)
pinout.basis: Function Diagram on page 1 (package top view: bottom row 1-2-3, top row 6-5-4, dot at pin 1; schematic shows pin 5 as the top rail, pin 2 as ground, I/O at 1, 3, 4, 6). The datasheet has no separate pin-description table. Same roles as USBLC6-2SC6, so no remap; on this board 1&6 = USB_DP and 3&4 = USB_DM.

designer_notes: VBUS may reach 5.25 V (> Vrwm 5.0 V but < Vbr 6.0 V min): leakage is specified only at 5.0 V, expect slightly more at 5.25 V; harmless for USB.
Datasheet markets it for CAN/automotive and gives no USB-specific data; 1.0 pF to GND / 0.5 pF I/O-I/O is far below what USB 2.0 full-speed needs.
Clamp is 13.5 V typ / 15 V max at 4 A 8/20 us; compare against the USBLC6's own clamp figure when judging RP2040 pin stress.
